candidates.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Sell Over 45 Million Copies Before March 31st, Say Analysts
candidates.excerpt:
According to BMO Capital Markets’ Brian Pitz, around 45 million copies of
GTA 6
are expected to sell in the first quarter of its release.

candidates.title: Can GTA 6 make $2 billion in its opening weekend? One industry analyst has run the numbers, and seems to think so
candidates.excerpt:
At least, that's according to one analyst, Joost van Dreunen, a senior data analyst and great writer/numbers diviner who wrote some predictions in his respected
SuperJoost PlayList newsletter
. "My prediction: Take-Two announces opening-weekend sales above $2 billion by Monday, 23rd November," he wrote. And you know what? I reckon he's onto something.

pairs.reason: Separate analyst publications: GamingBolt reports the IBD analyst roundup including Brian Pitz first-quarter copies; Eurogamer reports Joost van Dreunen’s SuperJoost newsletter opening-weekend revenue forecast. Shared GTA launch context is not the same forecast.
